2607.26751.title: Phoneme- vs. Character-Level Targets and Selective State-Space Models for Intracortical Brain-to-Text
2607.26751.paper_summary: State-of-the-art intracortical brain-to-text systems pair a neural-sequence phone decoder with an external language model. Two design axes remain underexplored: whether selective state-space models (Mamba) improve on recurrent decoders, and how the output target (phonetic vs.\ character) interacts with that choice. On the public Brain-to-Text '25 benchmark, we study a controlled 2x2 grid (GRU vs.\ hybrid Mamba decoder; phonetic vs.\ character targets) trained with a CTC objective under one reproducible protocol. The recurrent baseline remains strongest: the best phonetic GRU reaches 12.62\% PER and 21.19\% WER, while the best textual GRU after LM rescoring reaches 13.39\% CER and 26.28\% WER. The Mamba hybrid is competitive but does not surpass it. Ablations isolate architectural contributions, and error analysis shows representation-dependent failures: articulatory-like phoneme confusions vs.\ lexical and word-boundary errors.
2607.26751.paper_summary_zh: 最先進的皮層內腦-文本系統將神經序列音素解碼器與外部語言模型配對。兩個設計軸仍然未被充分探索：選擇性狀態空間模型（Mamba）是否優於遞歸解碼器，以及輸出目標（音素 vs. 字符）如何與該選擇互動。在公共的腦-文本 '25 基準上，我們研究了一個受控的 2x2 網格（GRU vs. 混合 Mamba 解碼器；音素 vs. 字符目標），該網格在一個可重現的協議下使用 CTC 目標進行訓練。遞歸基線仍然是最強的：最佳音素 GRU 達到 12.62% PER 和 21.19% WER，而最佳文本 GRU 在 LM 重新評分後達到 13.39% CER 和 26.28% WER。Mamba 混合解碼器具有競爭力，但未超越它。消融實驗隔離了架構貢獻，錯誤分析顯示出依賴於表示的失敗：發音類似的音素混淆 vs. 詞彙和單詞邊界錯誤。
